svg.title: Budget the check before the pilot
svg.desc: Proposed staff review budget: model scans up to 300 transcripts, nominates five linked excerpts; teacher checks those plus two random transcripts in ten minutes. This is a pilot budget rather than measured throughput.

g.text: Budget the check before the pilot
Model nominates excerpts; time this pass separately.
Pilot budget, not measured throughput. If it overruns:
sample less or fund the review.
